name: Kullu Nafsin Dha'iqatul Mawt Gold Acrylic Calligraphy
short_desc: Exude dark luxury with this textured stone medallion featuring Kullu nafsin dha'iqatul mawt in raised gold acrylic script. Suspended inside a floating metallic gold hoop with a protective varnish finish, it makes a dramatic statement on deep green or dark feature walls.
seo_title: Luxury Floating Ring Stone Medallion Art – Kullu Nafsin Dha'iqatul Mawt Gold Acrylic Calligraphy
description:
Make a dramatic, high-fashion statement with this luxury sculptured Islamic art installation. The centerpiece is a heavy-textured black stone medallion bearing the sobering Quranic verse Kullu nafsin dha'iqatul mawt ("Every soul shall taste death") in raised, handcrafted gold script.

Crafted with premium acrylic paints and metallic gold pigment on a stone-like disc, the medallion is set within a floating metallic gold ring against subtle gold-line geometric background wall details.

Sealed with a protective gloss varnish finish, the gold paint retains its brilliant luster, while the textured black disc remains shielded from dust and discoloration over time.

Designed for moody, luxurious spaces, this artwork excels on emerald green, navy blue, or charcoal feature walls, paired with warm ambient lighting and metallic decor.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Raised acrylic paint and metallic gold pigment on textured disc with metal ring frame

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for metallic shine and color durability

Theme & Script: Kullu nafsin dha'iqatul mawt (Surah Al-Imran: 185)

Color Palette: Textured black disc, shimmering gold calligraphy, and gold metal hoop

Style: Luxury Sculptural / Moody Modern Art

Ideal Placement: Dark green or charcoal feature wall, formal lounge, or luxury dining area
